reason: Best supported quality-first choice: both measured runs retained full BF16 quality, while int3-g128 fell to 0.80 and mixed3-4-g128 reached only 0.85. Its measured throughput also exceeded the 95% gate in both runs. It is the lowest-memory measured recipe with demonstrated quality at or above 0.95; 2-bit and other mixed recipes lack qualifying quality evidence. Falsifiable hypothesis: on the unchanged workload and gates, repeat runs will retain at least 0.95 quality and throughput while using less peak MLX memory than BF16.
risk: Only two trials, from the first search block with no heldout tasks, support this recommendation. The quality sample is limited; the memory and throughput figures are observed results, not guarantees.
